name: R360 Cron: Daily LeadOps Report (8am Central)

nodes.name: Schedule: 8am Central daily
nodes.notes: Cron in UTC: 13:00 = 8am CST / 7am CDT. Adjust seasonally OR use TZ-aware cron expression.

parameters.query:
SELECT Source__c source, Decision_Path__c path, COUNT(Id) count
FROM Lead_Inbound_Log__c
WHERE Received_At__c = LAST_N_DAYS:1
GROUP BY Source__c, Decision_Path__c
ORDER BY Source__c, Decision_Path__c
